upstream.license_note: The pinned upstream license declares Darknet public domain.

changes: isolate forward_crop_layer_kernel and its pixel/bilinear helpers from Darknet host and image-adjustment dependencies
make batch explicit and derive size as batch * channels * crop_height * crop_width
replace the per-batch rand buffer with explicit finite r4/r5/r6/r7 scalars shared across the adapter's reviewed batch subset
guard the reviewed batch/channel/image/crop domain before payload access
export the original one-evaluation body as darknet_forward_crop_orig512
add darknet_forward_crop_vgeo as a separately named grid-stride derived variant

abi: darknet_forward_crop_{orig512,vgeo}(float* input, float* output, uint32_t batch, uint32_t channels, uint32_t height, uint32_t width, uint32_t crop_height, uint32_t crop_width, int32_t train, int32_t flip, float angle, float r4, float r5, float r6, float r7)

variants.name: darknet_forward_crop_orig512
variants.note: The per-thread body retains upstream single-evaluation ownership; the registered domain contains at most 512 output elements.

variants.name: darknet_forward_crop_vgeo
variants.note: Only output-index ownership changes. Each output has no reduction or cross-thread state and executes the same floating-point helper sequence, so byte equality is expected only when both variants use the same compiler flags and CUDA device; the GPU probe enforces that condition.

probe.oracle: Upstream-style orig512 launch with ceil(size/512) blocks compared byte-for-byte with singleton-grid vgeo launches at every registered block candidate.
